layout.wide: contextual explorer at left; selected-entity identity header + tabs/content center/right; collapsible workbook/activity panel where useful
layout.narrow: same semantic hierarchy/actions through stacked explorer/detail navigation; no action or warning lost solely because width changes
layout.scroll: explorer, entity content and activity/review surfaces own independent bounded scrolling where present

explorer.rule: tree arrangement is contextual projection; containment and physical Site/Room/Rack hierarchy remain visually distinguishable and never imply connectivity

entity_header.actions: contextual, permission/action-proof gated; archived/history state remains readable

separation_cues: Rack placement and containment use different labels/icons/sections
Cloud is never shown as physical parent
IP cards say descriptive inventory and never Connected/Reachable
Model Compatibility and Installed Components are separate views
Device Reference retains its own operational identifier next to resolved Network Element rather than being replaced by Network Element name

device_reference_promotion.gesture: one continuous 3-second deliberate hold with visible semantic progress
device_reference_promotion.server_rule: successful client interaction submits LLD-12 session-bound DeliberateActionProof; client duration boolean/timestamp alone is rejected
device_reference_promotion.review: candidate Network Elements show evidence dimensions but no automatically selected identity; user chooses existing or new registration

site_creation.rule: Site and dedicated Dispatch Location are presented as two identities; Dispatch Location initial name may mirror Site but current address is derived from Site

placement_editor.rule: changing Rack does not visually imply containment/Cloud changes

rules: replacement history shows old and new component identities
maintenance-derived component changes show source Task/Inventory consequence provenance without allowing Task editing
removed components remain in history/filterable list
removing current primary never silently promotes another
blank-preserve is displayed as No change
source file is identified as read-only/operator-managed
accept is disabled while any selected mutation is unresolved/invalid/stale

empty_loading_error.every primary view: has explicit empty/loading/bounded-error/retry state; errors do not erase last accepted data
empty_loading_error.workbook errors: show per-file reason without suggesting source workbook was modified

accessibility: keyboard navigation and actions have visible focus
no icon-only destructive/material action without accessible label
hold progress has non-visual status announcement
validation errors associate with fields and summary
tiny text and ultrawide-only layout are prohibited
